Best of all, the experience is completely free. What more could you ask for?

events.title: Enjoy Time Out Market Club Discounts
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: If you live in Catalonia and are over 18, the Time Out Market Club is for you. Joining is free and easy: just fill in the registration form and download the digital card to your phone, available for both iPhone and Android. Once you’ve added it to your digital wallet, you can start enjoying all the benefits.
